name: Wema
source: NGX audited annual report FY2025, Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), GROUP column only. CORRECTED 2026-10-04: the stored series had interleaved the Group and Bank columns as if they were consecutive financial years, so FY2024 held Bank FY2025 figures, FY2023 held Group FY2024 and FY2022 held Bank FY2024. The columns are rebuilt on the Group column; the Bank duplicate columns are dropped because they are the same session restated for the separate entity, not earlier years.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Group total of interest income, net fee and commission income, net trading income, other income and net gain on FVTPL securities. FY2023 is the Group gross earnings already carried for that year (226,914,538 thousand), matching the published FY2023 figure.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Personnel expenses + Depreciation and amortisation + Other operating expenses, Group column, page 122.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Printed subtotal Operating income, the nearest schema label for a bank.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Printed line Profit before taxation.
rows.note: FIX 2026-10-04: restored. The cell was nulled while this file stored NGN thousands; the file was then normalised to absolute naira (x1000) and the cell was left blank. Source: the file's NGX discovery record, profit_before_tax 154,556,746 thousand, https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47610_WEMA_BANK_PLC.-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Printed line Income tax expense, stored as a positive charge so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit.

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Printed line Profit for the year for FY2025 and FY2024. FY2023 is Profit Before Tax less Income Tax on the FY2023 column the file already carried, tagged derived.
rows.note: FIX 2026-10-04: restored. The cell was nulled while this file stored NGN thousands; the file was then normalised to absolute naira (x1000) and the cell was left blank. Source: the file's NGX discovery record, profit_after_tax 131,373,234 thousand, https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47610_WEMA_BANK_PLC.-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf

rows.label: EPS
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Printed line Earnings per share, basic and diluted (kobo). H1 2026 from the company interim filing.

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.not_available: A bank reports interest expense inside net interest income, so there is no separate net finance cost line to show.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity

derivation.ratiosNote: ratio cells tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures of this security, not printed in the source
